data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, not contingent on unanimity. Each of the other 24: choose 18, 10, or a counteroffer; state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if filled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, leaving250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Even all18 leaves50, but recovery isn't guaranteed and long-run income may suffer. Intentions aren't binding; other catches require recalculation. Fellow recruiters: help seek individual choices.
